limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

findings.text: 熟悉profile备份/恢复的本机维护者，在可弃置副本核一个可信非关键包更新，见 [Q01](#research-q01)/[Q05](#research-q05)。
官方RPC或本机gateway→锁内重读profile/registry与compat→内存job→CLI/native真实writer→依赖/版本/选择/预检后验→必要重启，见 [Q02](#research-q02)。

本组件package、Host/client apply/face、工具条/内置toggle代表路径；registry/compat/更新route到CLI/native/后验与done；新install冲突回滚/预检；队列、启动修复、patch/manifest写盘和restart计划执行。未运行/全审所有迁移、平台shim、全部profile选择、上游writer/Loader/HMR、进程树、供应链/云端。
原生Host/Web子包0.4.15，官方插件页附加管理能力；CLI、官方RPC/manager与Loader能力分别归因。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金/资源 | 人工与未知 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | 下载/磁盘/registry | 备份/来源/通道/profile核实 |
| 持续 | 网络/包与日志 | 版本审阅/停机回归/DOM兼容 |
| 失败 | 重试/脚本可能已执行 | 查job/依赖/修复/真实进程 |
| 退出 | 保留证据/恢复旧依赖 | 不撤回脚本副作用；工时价格未知 |
先副本备份并核自动修复，只更新一个可信非关键包，逐层核job/磁盘/加载/功能；后台或恢复未知时停操作查writer，再退固定CLI和人工回归，见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

#### 效果

| 项目 | 当前支持 | 未验证 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 检查更新 | registry/Host要求与两通道 | peer-only默认抓取缺字段 |
| 写入后验 | 依赖/精确版本/选择检查 | 插件运行与业务结果 |
| 回滚 | 条件remove/装回旧spec | 全部文件/副作用恢复 |
| 重启 | 按进程形态选择 | 新进程健康/功能通过 |
| 使用收益 | 集中页内管理 | 净省时/需求/总成本 |
真实writer和后验区分受理/落盘/加载有价值；单实例队列并非全局事务，启动修复、半失败和包脚本需独立核目标，见 [Q02](#research-q02)-[Q04](#research-q04)。
将多通道更新接入官方页面，真实写后核目标版本，并分已落盘/需重启；CLI冲突检查和有限回滚有明确定向路径，见 [Q02](#research-q02)-[Q04](#research-q04)。
检查时版本未绑定请求，默认registry响应未透传peer要求；启动自动修复不进常规队列、done/回滚退出码不证明实际加载和恢复，见 [Q02](#research-q02)-[Q04](#research-q04)。
绑定expectedVersion/来源差异再审并独立核重启后加载，对照现有固定spec与人工清单；若无意外版本/误信下降或总维护更重即否定，见 [Q06](#research-q06)。

#### 依赖

| 条件 | 用途 | 边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 匹配DSH/React/Web与成品 | 官方页注入 | DOM/slot随上游变 |
| 正确profile/可写文件/备份 | 安装/启停/修复 | 启动即可能修复写patch |
| registry与CLI/包管理器 | 普通gateway | 非来源安全验证 |
| desktop官方manager | 应用自有profile写入 | 上游事务未全审 |
| 本机可信用户/包来源 | 变更权限 | 无人批token，包可执行代码 |
| 进程所有者/重启方案 | 加载新版本 | manual/需回归 |

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)安装/版本/队列均成熟，Host多writer局部整合使novelty25%超0，非新范式不达50%。[Q02](#research-q02)-[Q04](#research-q04)真实后验/owner冲突回滚/加载分层使mechanism50%超25%页面包装，peer字段/恢复与运行未验不达75%。transferability50%，[Q03](#research-q03)写入与运行结果拆分可迁移超25%局部脚本，缺跨平台验收不达75%。simplification25%，[Q05](#research-q05)集中步骤超0，备份/回归与多writer维护仍重不达50%。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)/[Q05](#research-q05)集中官方页/批量不改责任或任务组织，workflow不达25%。交付仍插件安装，同一维护者负责回归，后验未形成新交付责任机制，delivery不达25%。未识别此前受限明确群体和约束解除，UI便利不使reach达25%。无资源供给/服务结构改变，节步骤与现金未知不使economics达25%。

recommendation.reason: 熟悉 profile 恢复的本机维护者，可在备份过的可弃置副本试更新一个可信非关键包。它把多通道检查、写后版本核对和重启条件集中到官方插件页。若目标版本、后台进程或恢复结果不明，应停止后续更新，核实际状态后退回固定版本 CLI 与人工回归。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)/[Q05](#research-q05)维护者/单包/可核功能明确，50%超25%泛管理；真实持续需求与体验未验不达75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)集中检查/后验超0无差异，25%；字段遗漏/版本未绑定和恢复负担不足50%稳定相对收益。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)-[Q04](#research-q04)真CLI/native调用、精确回读、失败/重启已查，50%超25%声明；未运行/全审上游/平台/功能不达75%。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03)-[Q05](#research-q05)本机代码执行/自动修复/备份回归重，25%不达50%轻负担；单包副本和固定CLI退路超0。

publication.summaries.text: 在 DSH 官方插件页集中检查第三方更新，按通道调用官方写入器并核对落盘版本与重启条件。

items.Host 路由: 本机job/更新/启停/重启网关

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 用途 | 条件与边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 页内检查/批量 | 第三方registry更新 | 首失败停，非整批事务 |
| 双通道/多writer | 复用官方机制 | 本包门不覆盖官方RPC |
| 后验 | 依赖/版本/选择/组合 | 非import/apply与功能验收 |
| 启停 | 写entry覆盖/官方内置toggle | 需分当前/下次/被覆盖 |
| 重启 | manual/shell/systemd/helper | 202非健康证明 |
| 启动修复 | 修失效row name | 自动写且不在常规队列 |

publication.advice.text: 先副本备份并核自动修复，只更新一个可信非关键包，逐层核job/磁盘/加载/功能；后台或恢复未知时停操作查writer，再退固定CLI和人工回归，见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

      "path": "packages/dsh-plugin-manager/README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-plugin-manager · Client Plugin Manager & Lifecycle Control UI for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)\n\nEnglish | [中文](README.zh.md)\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager?style=flat-square\" alt=\"Version\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.2--rc.1-4c6ef5?style=flat-square&labelColor=454a54\" alt=\"DSH\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue?style=flat-square\" alt=\"License\">\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <strong>Client Plugin Manager & Lifecycle Control UI for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)</strong><br>\n  <em>Installed Plugin Version Checks · One-Click Batch Updates · Runtime Compatibility Gate · Safety Rollback · Dual Channels</em>\n</p>\n\nAn update and lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI and official desktop client: adds real-time registry version comparisons with DSH runtime compatibility checks directly into the official Plugins page, providing list-level batch updates, safe rollback mechanisms, and restart-to-apply workflows.\n\n## What it does\n\n- Contributes a check-for-updates block into the official Plugins page (the `plugins.detail.section` seat that page declares), rendered on an installed bundle's page and nowhere else. There is no tab of its own in the Plugins settings section.\n- Adds a list-level toolbar beside that page's **Installed** heading. The heading is the page's own chrome and the page declares no seat beside it (its extension points are `plugins.detail.*`, `plugins.item`, `plugins.bundle.config`, `plugins.row.config` and `plugins.bundle.activation`), so the toolbar is inserted into that element and kept in place through the family's shared body-mutation hub. One click checks every installed plugin; the panel lists the third-party rows that have a newer release, with the declared DSH minimum for any row this runtime is too old for; **Update all** applies the eligible rows one at a time with per-row progress and stops at the first failure, leaving the rest listed; **Restart now** then makes the update effective (see the restart note under Known limitations). Official `@deepseek-ai/` packages are never updated in bulk — their version belongs to the DSH installation.\n- Dual-channel transport: on runtimes with the official installer services (DSHCode and the 1.0.4 checkout web), every operation rides the official `/plugin-installer` and `/plugin-control` loopback RPC channels; on the npm-published web runtime those channels do not exist, so the package's host half mounts a loopback-fenced HTTP gateway that spawns the official `dsh plugin` CLI for installs/removals (the single writer) and writes `disabled` override rows for enablement. An application-owned profile (a packaged Desktop launch) takes the third writer for installs, updates and removals: the official in-process plugin manager the host mounts, because the CLI refuses to write that profile at all.\n- Detects the legacy aggregate `@linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all` and converts its update action into a transactional migration to `@linxin666/dsh-web-all`; the gateway removes the legacy package, installs the current package at an exact version, restores the legacy layer position, and verifies `--dump-config` before reporting success.\n- Verifies DSH runtime compatibility before npm updates (issue #754): update checks read the declared minimum DSH version from the latest manifest (`dsh.engines.dsh` with a top-level `engines.dsh` fallback), evaluate it as a node-semver range with the call the official boot gate makes — `semver.satisfies(host, range, { includePrerelease: true })` — so `||` alternatives, `^` and `~`, whitespace-separated comparators and x-ranges decide here exactly as they decide at boot, and show the requirement beside the update action. A requirement the running DSH does not satisfy disables the action and says to upgrade DSH. A requirement the host could not verify — an unreadable running version, or a declaration that is not a range node-semver parses — is a different verdict with its own copy: it names no cause and never sends the user to upgrade a DSH that was never compared. Update writes apply at the next restart.\n\n## Cordis service\n\nThe browser half provides the shared dual-channel face as the cordis service `pluginManager`, so sibling client plugins can drive and observe plugin management without re-implementing the channel detection. Consume it with `ctx.inject(['pluginManager'], cb)` and read `ctx.pluginManager`:\n\n- `isLoopback: boolean` — whether this browser has loopback authority to use the host routes.\n- `list(): Promise<InstalledPluginItem[]>` — read the installed snapshot.\n- `install(spec): Promise<InstalledPluginItem>` — install one plugin from an npm spec or git URL.\n- `uninstall(id): Promise<InstalledPluginItem[]>` — remove one plugin.\n- `status(): Promise<InstallProgressItem>` — read the current install/update progress.\n- `failures(): Promise<PluginFailuresSnapshot>` — read the recorded plugin boot-failure ring (plugin id, message, stack, install path); runtimes without a ring answer an empty snapshot.\n- `setEnabled(id, enabled): Promise<InstalledPluginItem>` — flip one plugin's next-start enablement through the active channel (official installer RPC or gateway patch `disabled` row); takes effect after the host restart.\n- `onChange(cb): () => void` — subscribe to successful mutations; fires after `install()`, `update()`, `uninstall()`, or `setEnabled()` resolves, and returns the unsubscribe function.\n\nThe contract source of truth is `src/core/service.ts` (`PluginManagerService`). The service and the update block share one face, so `onChange` subscribers observe the same mutations.\n\n## Known limitations\n\n- Loopback-only: on a LAN or remote browser the update block renders a local-only notice (the same boundary the official installer page enforces; the gateway refuses non-loopback requests with 403).\n- On the npm-published web runtime, gateway writes go through the official CLI. A Node-script CLI (an npm or homebrew shim, a `.bin` symlink, a `lib/bin.js`) runs under an interpreter resolved without PATH: the `node` installed beside the CLI when the installation ships one, otherwise the host's own interpreter. The CLI's own directory goes first on the child PATH, so the `dsh plugin` run finds the pnpm installed beside it. If no source contains the CLI, CLI-backed writes remain unavailable — an application-owned profile writes through the official in-process manager and needs no binary, so its install, update and removal routes never demand one. CLI output is decoded as bytes in one pass, so a Windows console's code page (CP936/GBK) renders as readable text instead of replacement characters. Installs of git sources can take minutes and run as background jobs. Gateway updates apply only to npm registry sources, resolve the latest version on the host, and succeed only after the same installed package reports that exact version.\n- An application-owned profile (the packaged Desktop client) runs installs, updates and removals through the official in-process plugin manager the host mounts, the same writer that profile's official Plugins page drives: the CLI refuses `--profile desktop` outright, and the launcher hands that manager its bundled package-manager invocation. The manager's own verdict is read before the profile is: it resolves a refused run with `application: 'failed'` instead of rejecting, so the job reports that run's real reason (the pnpm diagnostic, or the packages an incompatible-version refusal names) rather than a no-op after an unchanged profile. Every other runtime keeps the CLI as the single writer of installs, updates and removals.\n- Compatibility gating applies only when the target manifest declares a minimum DSH version; packages without `dsh.engines.dsh` update unchecked, and official-installer runtimes (DSHCode and the checkout web) are not gated here because their updates go through the official installer. Enabling a row the bundle disables writes an explicit `disabled: false` override, because deleting the user row would only restore the bundle default; the runtime's loader honors these rows at the next start, but this path is less exercised than the official desktop writer's.\n- Restart is explicit, user-clicked and four-mode. The route is method-aware: `GET /api/plugin-manager/restart` reads the plan (returning `{ restart: { mode, unit? } }` with no side effects, so a prefetch or a typed URL can never stop a host) and `POST` carries it out (responding with `{ restart: { mode } }`); every other method is refused with 405. The toolbar reads the plan first, so the confirmation names the same consequence the host will produce. On a terminal launch (`dsh web`) the host starts a detached helper that waits for the outgoing process to exit and then re-executes the same command line, so the port is free before the replacement binds it, and the replacement's output goes to `$DSH_HOME/logs/plugin-manager-restart.log`. Without that guarantee the restart panel states that this process cannot restart itself, names the manual way out (quit DeepSeek Harness and open it again), and offers no confirmation button: that path would not restart anything. A launch with no terminal and no provable systemd user service (a supervisor, an editor task) is left running and the toolbar says to restart manually. Without a restart, updated plugin code is loaded at the next start.\n- On the npm runtime, duplicate insert-id claims are detected after install and the new plugin is rolled back automatically (a shared id can never be `disabled` away: the loader's duplicate check has no disabled exemption).\n- The npm runtime's boot preflight (`--dump-config`) catches composition failures, and the static insert check catches insert rows naming packages that resolve nowhere; runtime import/apply failures still surface only at the next real start.\n- Duplicate-mount safeguard (gateway mode): the official CLI's bundle reconciliation re-adds every bundle-declaring dependency to `dsh.profile.bundles` after any install/remove — including packages the composition already mounts through a patch row (a bundle that mounts an external plugin by row), which would double-mount and fail the next boot (`duplicate prefix route`). There is no browser-reachable path from a remote origin; rejected requests receive HTTP 403 with `{ ok: false, error: \"forbidden: loopback-only\" }`.\n- Mutation routes (install / update / remove / set-enabled / restart) carry no token: the loopback authority *is* the local user, matching the official channels. The restart route is the one route whose effect is process-level: it never invents a command line (it re-executes this process's own `execPath` + argv, dropping inspector flags), it refuses to relaunch anything it cannot identify as a terminal launch or a provable systemd user service (delegating solely to `systemctl --user restart <unit>` while leaving system scope and other supervision in manual mode), and under the packaged Desktop app it stops this process only when the shell declares `DSH_SHELL_RESTARTS_HOST=1`. Any local process can therefore drive plugin installs and removals, and npm installs run package install scripts — treat the gateway as local code execution by design and never expose it beyond loopback.\n- Install specs and package ids are rejected when they contain command-shell expansion characters or control characters. On Windows, npm shims are resolved to `node.exe` plus the package `bin.js`; packaged Desktop shims have no adjacent npm layout, so they run through `cmd.exe /d /s /c` with a pre-quoted, verbatim argument envelope. That command processor is addressed by absolute path (`ComSpec`, otherwise `%SystemRoot%\\System32\\cmd.exe`) instead of by bare name, so a host whose PATH omits the system directories still runs the shim; a spawn that still fails settles as a failed job carrying the reason instead of taking the dsh host process down. Desktop profile discovery reads the packaged launcher's profile environment value or persisted profile selection, and application-owned profile installs, updates and removals run in the host half through the mounted official `pluginManager` service — the same writer that profile's official Plugins page drives through its own RPC face — under the same loopback fence and user click.\n- Mutations are serialized through one queue, so concurrent jobs never interleave their before/after profile captures. An install is only `done` when the new dependency actually landed in the profile (and a removal only when it is gone); a success exit code alone is never trusted.\n- Enablement re-reads the current profile manifest under that mutation queue and rejects stale or unknown package ids with `404` before writing, so a panel row left behind by an uninstall cannot create an orphan `disabled` override.\n- Conflict handling is owner-aware: a duplicate entry id or an insert row naming an unresolvable package rolls the *new* package back through the official remove path. The published profile outranks the variable because the packaged Desktop client exports neither and a global `DSH_PROFILE` workaround can name a profile the running Host never reads.\n- The launched profile the Host publishes is foreign input: its name is traversal-checked, its directory must be an absolute traversal-free path, and its patch path is accepted only when it is that profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` — the patch path is a write target. README](packages/dsh-task-board/README.zh.md)）。任务看板不仅仅是一个可视化卡片界面，更是 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Web GUI 与桌面客户端中的**宿主权威后台长程执行与多 Agent 自动化调度引擎**。任务按“待规划、待办、进行中、已完成、已失败”五列进行全生命周期管理，支持项目分区、粘贴文本 AI 解析与卡片多模态附件（每卡最多 8 个图片或文件附件，经官方附件存储 SHA256 核验，执行时图片作为多模态部件入队、文件以只读路径注入），以 Schema v7 事务账本为权威持久化核心，真正实现了长程任务从拆解、父卡自治派发、对抗质检到外部成果闭环的全流程自动化：\n\n- **宿主权威后台驱动与 7x24 小时离线无人值守**：区别于传统仅在前端网页轮询的脆弱看板，所有卡片流转、调度触发与执行监控完全由 DSH 后端 Host 进程作为唯一权威驱动。支持循环 5 字段 Cron 表达式（绑定 IANA 时区与可选 `maxRuns` 次数预算）与单次未来时刻（`once`）两类定时计划；浏览器仅为异步视图，关闭网页标签页、熄灭屏幕或断开网络，后台智能体会话照常并发执行与原子落盘结算。内置跨平台防休眠电源管理（macOS `caffeinate`、Windows `ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED`、带有 systemd-logind 的 Linux `systemd-inhibit`），允许显示器正常关闭的同时阻止整机因闲置休眠，确保夜间无人值守巡检与流水线准时打卡。\n- **树状子任务与父卡自治派发（Subtask Trees & Autonomous Parent Dispatch）**：复杂工程目标可拆解为 1 至 3 层树状子任务（内置环路与深度护栏）。执行任意卡片只为该卡片自身开启**唯一一个**会话，Host 绝不为子任务批量派生独立会话；当执行的卡片存在未完成后代时，Host 自动在本次运行中强制切入 `liangshen`（梁神模式）调度者预设，并在启动 Prompt 中注入未完成子卡清单，由父会话通过 `task_board_get` 逐张读取子卡详情、按依赖顺序通过 `subagent` 自治派发（互不依赖的子任务并发执行），完工前调用 `task_board_manage({ action: 'record-external-outcome' })` 一次性回填各子卡结论（未显式回填的后代由 Host 在父卡终结时幂等兜底结算）。多张独立卡片在同一时刻触发时，由受控准入队列（`runLaunchWidth`，1 至 16，默认 3）治理并发创建会话的宽度。\n- **对抗式双盲质量验收门禁（No False Completion）**：彻底终结 AI 编程中“自述已完成、实则未改动或改崩溃”的虚假交付顽疾。以 goal 形式执行的任务在 Agent 试图调用 `update_goal(complete)` 宣告完工的瞬间被 Host 强制拦截，必须由独立的裁判模型（可自选模型与思考档位）进行真实验收。验收机制沿用严苛的 Coding 质量判据、0.65 绝对通过阈值，每项判据双轮交换 A/B 位置打分消偏，并严格结合会话执行轨迹与宿主工作区真实磁盘文件的 Diff 行级变更审查。首轮未达标精准下发具象结构化问题引导 Agent 自我修复，两次仍不通过才判负，杜绝敷衍糊弄。\n- **GitHub Issues、云端团队协作与手机远端三路扩展**：通过标准外部提供方契约无缝挂载三大官方扩展：[dsh-client-ui-task-board-github](packages/dsh-task-board-github/README.zh.md) 实现任务看板与 GitHub Issues / PR 状态的双向实时同步，远端 Issue 自动入列驱动 Agent 定位修复、运行测试、创建关联 运行时与高效调度引擎）\n\n在新建会话输入框左侧通过专属老虎机拨杆切换，或在“设置 > Agent 预设”中选用。梁神模式（`dsh-liangshen`）是专为追求**极致推理效率、超低静态上下文开销与严苛工程执行纪律**而深度重构的杀手级预设与运行时插件。针对主流大模型在长程编程任务中容易出现的系统提示词冗长膨胀、工具 Schema 挤占上下文、思维链无效空转（如“流水账推理”）以及多轮遗忘退化等痛点，梁神模式通过原生极简提示词、程序化代码工具调用（PTC）、MCP 温和分页与关键事实局部就近投射，提供纯粹而强悍的编程作战体验：\n\n- **极简 Persona 与严苛行动导向纪律（Zero Prompt Waste）**：彻底剥离官方 Standard 预设中冗长繁琐的系统级条文，将提示词极致收敛为单行 Persona 与经过实战千锤百炼的高效工程纪律。内置反思熔断（同一假设推演不超过两轮，缺少事实立即闭合思考并调用原生工具探测，杜绝凭空揣测）、行动导向（思考过程仅用于决定下一步具体操作，严禁在思考中预演完整代码）、并发探索（单轮内并发派发多个独立检测或搜索工具）、YAGNI 与 PDCA 循环（单步验证单一假设，不写冗余注水注释）、以及有界收敛纪律（前置检查最多 2-3 轮即刻收敛，迅速转入实际作答或编辑）。大幅降低静态 Token 占用，让模型注意力百分之百倾注于业务与代码本身。\n- **程序化工具调用传输（PTC · Programmatic Tool Calling）**：彻底终结在每次请求中平铺上百个 JSON Schema 工具参数的低效模式。默认将网络线协议（wire）极致收拢为唯一的 `run_code`（运行 TypeScript 脚本），其余所有工具均通过自动生成的强类型 SDK 在独立的沙箱线程中以代码形式调用。无论系统注册了多少复杂工具，静态传输面始终保持极小体积；模型可原生利用 `Promise.all` 编写并发工具调用，并在程序内预先过滤、聚合、提取关键数据，只将精炼结论回传至对话上下文，从根本上解决大文本输出打爆 Token 的问题。对于习惯原生工具面的场景，亦可在插件设置中一键无缝切换为组装好的原生工具清单（Native）。\n- **MCP 工具温和分页与 LRU 动态激活（Gentle Tool Paging）**：针对海量 MCP 工具或第三方插件扩展，出厂默认启用温和分页（默认匹配 `mcp__*`）。外部工具在初始状态下仅以命名空间摘要形式登记在目录消息中，既不占 wire 协议也不进 SDK 声明；当大模型判定需要使用对应工具时，可自主调用 `tool_activate({ namespace })` 按需挂载。内置 LRU 策略（上限 3 个活跃命名空间），自动淘汰最久未用的命名空间，激活状态在会话压缩与恢复后完整重建，兼具海量工具接入能力与极致小巧的静态 Schema 面。\n- **关键事实登记簿与就近状态投射（Fact Register & Working Context）**：长程多轮对话中大模型极易遗忘早期的关键业务约束或踩过的坑。插件向模型提供专属 `fact_register` 工具，可将用户硬性约束、已确认的架构决策或失败路径登记为单行事实（每条不超过 160 字符，最多保留 12 条）。关键事实随 `[Working Context: ...]` 状态行在每一轮交互中就近投射至最新消息尾部的局部注意力窗口内，从物理机制上彻底解决长上下文“中间遗忘”与重复踩坑顽疾。\n- **原生调度者架构与敏捷访谈纪律（Dispatcher Identity & Triage）**：预设出厂深度集成调度者（Dispatcher）架构规范，赋能模型以团队指挥官身份统领工程任务。内置复杂度分诊机制（L0/L1 单点任务直接敏捷执行，L2 复杂任务严格遵循“澄清访谈 -> 架构规划 -> 并发子代理派发 -> 双层严格验收”标准流）；设定严格的提问预算控制（单轮最多 4 问、总计最多 3 轮、影响面排序、假设先行），杜绝无效拉扯；任务状态权威沉淀于 `todo_write`，杜绝浮躁的敷衍式交付。\n- **新建会话老虎机拨杆与炫酷中奖特效（Composer Slot Lever）**：在新建会话输入框工具行、模型选择器左侧，精心打造了一台复古老虎机拨杆控件。下拉拨杆（支持鼠标拖拽、单击或键盘快捷操作）即可一键为当前新建会话装配梁神模式，拉下命中即触发绚丽的中奖粒子特效（闪光、冲击环、火花粒子与专属彩蛋横幅）；上推即可平滑切回默认模式。拨杆自适应全局主题色彩，且在会话开始后自动隐藏，丝滑灵动，极具极客趣味。\n\n详细机制、评测数据与高级配置参数见 [dsh-liangshen README](packages/dsh-liangshen/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 智能体小队（Agent Squads · 可复用成员定义与整队协同运行）\n\n通过侧边栏“智能体”入口进入。智能体小队（`dsh-agents`）把跨会话复用的专业 AI 角色与团队编制沉淀为宿主权威账本：每个小队管理一组有序成员，既可按需单独点播某个成员开启专属会话，也可一键发起整队 Agent Teams 协同攻坚：\n\n- **可复用小队与成员定义（Reusable Squad & Member Definitions）**：小队支持配置名称、职责描述、可选绑定工作区与整队运行的 Lead 预设；每位成员独立钉住显示名称、Agent 预设（如梁神模式或研究小队预设）、沙箱权限、模型路由、推理思考强度与成员简报（Brief）。成员简报仅通过系统提示词段注入该成员专属会话，绝不污染首条用户消息或普通对话会话。\n- **整队 Agent Teams 协同运行与实时投影（Whole-Squad Runs & Live Projection）**：一键启动整队运行，小队名册与任务目标经 `team:squad` 系统提示词上下文直达 `<小队名> / Lead` 会话；Lead 按成员钉住的预设、权限与模型动态孵化专属 Teammate，任一钉子无法兑现立即 Fail-Closed 报错而不静默降级。前端直接读取共享会话存储中的 `agentTeam` 投影（`stateVersion` 4），实时呈现 Lead 与各 Teammate 的角色、执行阶段与启动异常，全程无需轮询。\n- **10 项全会话定义管理与启动工具（10 Model-Facing Management & Launch Tools）**：向宿主全体会话注册 `squads_list`、`squads_read`、`squads_create`、`squads_update`、`squads_delete`、`squad_member_add`、`squad_member_update`、`squad_member_remove`、`squads_run_member`、`squads_run_squad` 共 10 项进程内工具，支持对话中的 Agent 自主编排小队、点播单成员会话或发起整队运行，删除操作强制要求 `confirm: true` 安全确认。\n- **原子账本持久化与同源运行时避让（Atomic Ledger & Runtime Coexistence）**：定义与最新 200 条运行记录经临时文件 fsync + 原子 rename 持久化于 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-agents/ledger.json`（由 `ledger.json.lock` 保证单进程独占，损坏账本原样保留绝不覆盖）；当宿主已挂载官方 `agentTeams` 服务时自动避让内置团队运行时并无缝复用官方状态投影。\n\n详细契约、工具表与安全模型见 [dsh-agents README](packages/dsh-agents/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 实时浏览器视图（Browser View · 右侧栏 CDP 实时投屏与网页自动化）\n\n在会话右侧栏标签条或引导胶囊中打开。实时浏览器视图（`dsh-browser-view`）为 Agent 提供一个由宿主驱动、用户可在聊天旁侧实时观看的受控 Chromium 浏览器标签页，实现前端开发验证、视觉巡检与网页交互的全程可视化闭环：\n\n- **右侧栏 CDP 实时投屏与保活挂载（Right-Docked Screencast & Keep-Mounted View）**：注册专属右侧栏标签页类型 `browser-view`（与官方 `browser` 标签页和平共处），通过单条 WebSocket 实时绘制 CDP `Page.startScreencast` 画面帧、当前 URL、标题与 Agent 最近一次操作摘要；切换标签 chip 时保持挂载不断连，仅在页面变化时推流。\n- **默认隔离 Chromium 与真实已登录浏览器接管（Isolated Chromium & Real Browser Attach）**：默认惰性拉起带有一次性临时配置目录与随机调试端口的无头 Chromium（固定 1280x800 视口，访问本机 DSH Web GUI 遇 401 鉴权时自动内存取票完成登录）；开启 `realBrowserEnabled` 后可通过本地回环 CDP 端点（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:9222`）直接接管用户以非默认数据目录启动的 Chrome 或 Edge，直接在既有登录态下操作全部标签页，绝不导出或复制任何 Cookie。\n- **11 项受控浏览器交互工具（11 Agent Browser Tools）**：提供 `browser_navigate`、`browser_click`、`browser_type`、`browser_press`、`browser_scroll`、`browser_snapshot`、`browser_screenshot`、`browser_console`、`browser_network`、`browser_tabs`、`browser_close` 完整工具链；`browser_snapshot` 输出深度优先编号（`ref`）与坐标框的 DOM 结构树供精准点击与输入，每个标签页独立维护控制台日志与网络请求环形缓冲区。\n- **高保真无损区域截图与证据入列（Lossless Region Screenshots & Transcript Evidence）**：`browser_screenshot` 默认输出无损 PNG 并经宿主附件服务直接写入对话轨迹；支持传入与 `browser_snapshot` 同坐标系的 `clip: { x, y, width, height }` 进行局部区域裁剪（默认 2x 渲染倍率，可选 1x/2x/3x），显著提升模型视觉 Token 细节分辨率，越界裁剪或连接失败均显式报错而不静默回退。\n\n详细配置、真实浏览器启动参数与安全边界见 [dsh-browser-view README](packages/dsh-browser-view/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 手机 App 远程访问（Mobile Remote · 原生手机 App 接入）\n\n在 profile 中安装 [`@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge`](packages/dsh-remote-bridge/README.zh.md) 插件并重启服务后，点击侧边栏底部的二维码图标（aria-label 为「配对 iPhone」）打开配对面板。使用手机 App 扫码即可直接开始使用。\n\n配对面板具备本地安全保护，令牌路由（`/remote-bridge/pair/token`）带有回环门控，仅允许在本机浏览器中访问（非本机访问返回 403）。面板生成的配对码为一次性凭据，有效期为 30 秒，点击「重新取码」将作废上一张配对码。二维码编码包含服务地址与令牌的文档（URL 形如 `wss://<origin>/ios/v1?token=...`），手机 App 扫码后即可同时获取服务地址与鉴权令牌。\n\n网络接入协议面仅暴露 `/ios/v1` 一个 WebSocket 端点，隧道与局域网转发均指向仅放行该路径的入站闸门，公网无法直接访问 Web GUI 路由。服务地址按实时状态（中继租约或运行中的隧道）、环境变量 `DSH_REMOTE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` 以及局域网转发器实际监听地址的顺序解析。默认配置下公网可用（中继默认开启、隧道默认关闭、局域网转发默认关闭）；若需在局域网内直连，需在插件配置中开启局域网转发。\n\n[iOS App 还在内测，欢迎来 Discord 交流](https://discord.gg/nBy28kjun)。\n\n### 远程连接（SSH Ops · Web 终端、SFTP 传输与集群运维）\n\n通过侧边栏“SSH”入口打开远程运维面板（详见 [dsh-ssh README](packages/dsh-ssh/README.zh.md)）。支持密钥与密码认证，可一键导入本地 `~/.ssh/config` 主机列表；配置数据安全保存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` 中。面板提供以下操作能力：\n\n- **Web 终端**：基于 xterm.js 的完整远程交互终端，支持实时输出与窗口自适应；\n- **文件传输**：集成 SFTP 上传与下载功能，提供进度提示并支持可视化浏览远程目录；\n- **端口转发**：支持建立本地到远程内部服务的加密隧道（如内网数据库、后端 API），默认仅监听 127.0.0.1 安全地址；\n- **集群并发执行**：支持多主机批量命令执行，并可通过别名、运行环境或标签进行过滤；\n- **Agent 直连调用**：智能体与面板共享主机配置，在会话中发出指令即可委派 Agent 执行远程巡检与运维命令。\n\n### 使用统计（Usage Statistics · Token 消耗追踪、余额预警与 Token 银行）\n\n在“设置 > 使用统计”中集中查看 token 消耗数据、供应商余额以及编程套餐额度，支持自动定时刷新与手动即时查询。\n\n- **用量明细**：查看每日输入、输出与缓存用量，按不同供应商与模型细分展示，并提供最近 30 天消费趋势；支持的供应商提供账户余额查询，针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费与账单估算。\n- **个人套餐追踪**：实时展示 Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、Codex / ChatGPT 等平台编程套餐的使用比例与重置周期。\n- **Token 银行**：所有 provider 每消耗 100 万 tokens 铸造 1 鲸元，以“鲸元券”形式展示台账周期内的累计 token 与调用指标，支持保存票券卡片与系统级分享。\n- **桌面宠物联动**：安装宠物插件后，可通过桌面悬浮挂件的气泡提示直接查看当前会话供应商的额度、余额或今日消耗。\n\n统计自插件首次启用起计，不回填历史数据；鲸元券统计台账窗口内所有 provider 的 tokens（消费行仍只来自 DeepSeek 官方余额观测）。支持的供应商列表与配置细节见 [dsh-usage README](packages/dsh-usage/README.zh.md)。\n\n![DeepSeek Token 用量统计与 Token 银行 — API 消耗追踪与账单估算](docs/screenshots/35-usage-token-bank.webp)\n\n### 会话归档管理（Session Archive Manager · 全文检索与生命周期策略）\n\n会话归档管理（`dsh-session-archive`）是专为解决大量长短期会话堆积而设计的集中管理模块，随全家桶安装生效：\n\n- **集中检索与状态筛选**：统一呈现活跃会话、已归档会话、空白会话、子代理派生会话以及无工作区会话，支持按标题、工作区、状态及会话 ID 进行关键词搜索与多维排序；\n- **安全批量操作**：支持跨筛选结果的多选批量归档、批量恢复以及级联物理删除。执行物理删除时系统将明确提示受影响的后代会话数与预计释放空间，大批量删除需二次确认；当前处于运行中或带有运行中子代理的会话受到严格保护，防止误删；\n- **自动化生命周期策略**：提供两个默认关闭的自动化策略：根据最后活跃时间自动归档、根据归档时间自动清理超期数据，支持在启用前进行结果预览与单次手动执行。\n\n删除操作不可逆，所有管理路由严格限制本机回环访问。详细机制见 [dsh-session-archive README](packages/dsh-session-archive/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 系统要求\n\n- 已安装 DeepSeek Harness 且 `dsh web` 可正常启动。\n- npm 安装方式无需额外环境；若从源码仓库构建，需要 Node.js >= 24.9 与 pnpm 环境。\n\n### 三步上手（npm 安装，推荐）\n\n- **DSH Web CLI（现有浏览器服务）**：\n  1. 先完成三项构建脚本审批（见“安装排障”），再安装聚合包：`dsh 安装排障\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>展开查看常见安装与构建排障方案</strong></summary>\n\n<br>\n\n> **pnpm 严格依赖隔离导致模块找不到**：pnpm 的 isolated 模式默认仅将聚合包放置在顶层，部分子包可能被嵌套收敛，导致 `dsh web` 启动时报错 `Cannot find package '@linxin666/dsh-...'`。若遇到此情况，可在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中添加配置 `nodeLinker: hoisted`（或 `public-hoist-pattern: ['@linxin666/*']`）后重新安装。\n\n> **构建脚本被拦截 (ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS)**：这三项审批必须在首次 add 之前就位。正确顺序是重置 profile（官方 `--from-default-profile web`）或换新 profile，在 `<profile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里把三项写成映射，再执行 add：\n>\n> ```yaml\n> allowBuilds:\n>   cloudflared: true\n>   cpu-features: true\n>   ssh2: true\n> ```\n>\n> 必须写成上面的映射形式：列表形式会被 pnpm 改写成 `'0': cloudflared` 之类的占位条目，重跑时还会回退已解析的包（`Packages: -10`）。装失败后补审批重跑会 exit 0，但 `dsh.profile.bundles` 仍无该行：静默半挂载，重跑修不回来，需要先 remove 再 add。已带审批的存量 profile 升级不受影响。\n\n> **pnpm 11 发布时间门禁问题**：在包版本发布后的短时间内，pnpm 11 的默认安全策略（`minimumReleaseAge`）可能会尝试回退拉取旧版本。建议在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中排除相关命名空间以确保获取最新版本：\n>\n> ```yaml\n> minimumReleaseAgeExclude:\n>   - '@linxin666/*'\n> ```\n\n</details>\n\n## 兼容性与运行环境\n\ndsh-web 针对主流操作系统、现代化浏览器及网络拓扑进行了深度工程调优与兼容性保障：\n\n| 维度 | 支持范围与技术规格 |\n| --- | --- |\n| 宿主运行环境 | DeepSeek Harness 常见问题\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>安装重启后，侧边栏未显示插件入口？</strong></summary>\n\n请首先检查插件是否正确安装至 `web` profile（命令需包含 `--profile web`），并通过 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 验证配置层是否已成功挂载。注意仅刷新网页无法加载新模块，必须彻底重启 `dsh web` 后端服务进程。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>定时任务为何未能按时触发执行？</strong></summary>\n\n任务调度完全由 `dsh web` 后端宿主进程驱动，无需保持前端浏览器页面打开。若宿主进程退出、系统关机或整机进入深度睡眠，错过的触发时间点将遵循跳过策略处理，不执行回填补跑；若任务到达触发点时上一轮仍在运行，会自动顺延至下一个周期。若需要允许息屏但防止主机自动睡眠，可开启任务看板自带的电源保护选项。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>手机 App 配对后为何没有收到流式推送？</strong></summary>\n\n手机 App 通过协议 v1 的 WebSocket 通道与宿主通信。隧道或中继中断期间流式更新暂停，网络恢复后连接会自动重连；更新节奏的差异主要来自广域网往返延迟。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>试穿主题皮肤不满意如何还原？</strong></summary>\n\n皮肤面板提供免落盘试穿功能：点击试穿即刻在当前界面生效预览，离开面板或关闭预览会自动恢复初始外观；只有显式点击“应用”按钮才会将主题配置写入磁盘，可放心预览各类主题。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>是否可以仅使用主题皮肤或某个单一插件？</strong></summary>\n\n完全支持。若仅需要视觉定制，直接安装 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center` 即可；若仅需特定功能，参考“单独安装某个插件”章节直接安装对应 npm 包即可。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>已安装全家桶的前提下，能否额外独立安装某个子插件？</strong></summary>\n\n可以。聚合包内部的插件注册标识均统一带有 `web-ui-` 前缀（例如 `web-ui-usage`），与独立包的原生标识（如 `usage`）相互独立，不会产生 loader entry 重复冲突。宿主服务对同类插件会自动去重。通常情况下安装全家桶即可满足完整需求，无需重复安装单个子包。\n\n</details>\n\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>如何通过手机 App 远程访问 DeepSeek Harness？是否必须在同一 Wi-Fi 下？</strong></summary>\n\n手机远程访问由协议 v1 支撑，不要求必须处于同一 Wi-Fi。默认配置下插件已开启公网中继服务，在电脑端点击侧栏底部的二维码图标打开配对面板后，使用手机 App 扫码即可直接通过公网连接；亦可配置 Cloudflare 隧道。若希望在同一局域网内直连访问，需在插件配置中开启局域网转发并扫码配对。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>关闭浏览器或电脑休眠后，DeepSeek 的定时任务还会继续运行吗？</strong></summary>\n\n任务调度完全由 `dsh web` 后端宿主进程驱动，关闭浏览器标签页不影响定时任务的触发与执行。但如果整机进入深度睡眠或关机，宿主进程将暂停运行，离线期间错过的触发点会遵循跳过策略处理。若希望保持无人值守后台自动化，可在任务看板设置中开启“电源保护”选项，该选项会阻止系统因空闲进入休眠（允许显示器正常熄灭），确保定时任务准时触发。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>如何查看和监控 DeepSeek 及其他模型 API 的 Token 消耗与账户余额？</strong></summary>\n\n安装使用统计插件后，在“设置 > 使用统计”面板中可查看按日汇总的输入、输出与缓存 Token 数量，支持按模型细分查看 30 天消费趋势。针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费估算；若配置了支持查询余额的供应商 API，插件可定时拉取当前账户剩余额度与重置周期。\n\n</details>\n\n## 已知限制\n\n- 任务看板由后端 Host 进程统一调度，关闭前端标签页不影响任务执行；但若宿主进程停止或操作系统关机睡眠，处于离线期间的触发点将直接跳过不补跑。可选的电源保护仅阻止系统闲置睡眠，无法阻止用户主动合盖、手动休眠或电源切断，技术细节见 [dsh-task-board README](packages/dsh-task-board/README.zh.md)。\n- SSH 凭据（密码与私钥口令）保存在本地 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` 文件中（文件权限为 0600）；在网络中断重连时可能重新发送非幂等命令，终端输出保持原样返回不执行脱敏，安全规范见 [dsh-ssh README](packages/dsh-ssh/README.zh.md)。\n- 手机 App 流式交互经隧道或中继转发，广域网往返延迟叠加在每次更新上；固定域名中继比裸快速隧道多一跳，两者均可使用。\n- 从源码构建全仓需要 Node.js >= 24.9 与 pnpm 工具链，直接从 npm 安装不受此限制。\n\n##       "path": "packages/dsh-plugin-manager/src/client/BuiltinPlugins.tsx",
      "content": "/**\n * The \"Built-in plugins\" group at the bottom of the official Plugins page.\n *\n * By default it lists every global Loader entry no installed bundle contributes —\n * the rows a profile patch inserts itself (the Computer Use pair among them) and\n * the rows the host ships globally — each with the official manager's own switch,\n * so a row is enabled or disabled by exactly the call the official page makes.\n * One control widens that list to every Loader entry and names, on each row a\n * bundle adds, the bundle that adds it: those rows are the ones a reader also\n * meets on that bundle's own page, and the answer to \"why is this here twice\" is\n * that sentence. Below it, the agent preset compositions the same inventory\n * reports are rendered read-only: a preset's rows are composed per session and\n * only a Loader context can decide a `!!js` condition, so nothing here offers\n * them a switch.\n *\n * Every state shown is the Loader's own: after an accepted write the group\n * re-reads instead of trusting the answer, a refusal is named by the code the\n * manager returned, and a locked row says which lock it is.\n * @module @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager/client\n */\n\nimport { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from 'react'\nimport type { PropsLocale } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots'\nimport { Switch } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives'\nimport {\n  readChangeResult,\n  readRemoteAnswer,\n  selectBuiltinEntries,\n  type AgentPreset,\n  type AgentPresetRow,\n  type BuiltinRow,\n  type BundleFacts,\n  type DisplayText,\n  type PluginFacts,\n  type PluginInventory,\n  type WriteState,\n} from '../core/builtin.ts'\nimport type { ManagerFace, RemoteSnapshot } from './native-faces.ts'\nimport css from './plugin-manager.module.css'\n\n/** The operations the group drives, all of them the official manager's own. */\nexport interface BuiltinPluginsInjected {\n  /** The official faces, sampled on every render; its `version` moves on change. */\n  remote: RemoteSnapshot\n  /**\n   * Resolve package metadata text through the language the GUI is showing. The\n   * inventory hands back translations, not strings, and the mount owns no\n   * language of its own.\n   */\n  resolveText: (text: DisplayText) => string\n}\n\n/** Full component props. */\nexport type BuiltinPluginsProps =\n  & PropsLocale<'settings.pluginManager'>\n  & BuiltinPluginsInjected\n\n/** What the group knows about the deployment right now. */\ntype GroupState =\n  | { readonly kind: 'loading' }\n  | { readonly kind: 'unavailable' }\n  | { readonly kind: 'failed'; readonly code: string }\n  | {\n    readonly kind: 'ready'\n    /** The default scope: the rows no installed bundle contributes. */\n    readonly rows: readonly BuiltinRow[]\n    /** Every Loader entry, with `ownedBy` on the rows a bundle contributes. */\n    readonly allRows: readonly BuiltinRow[]\n    readonly presets: readonly AgentPreset[]\n    readonly bundles: 'confirmed' | 'unconfirmed'\n  }\n\n/** One line of feedback under the heading. */\ninterface Notice {\n  /** A refusal, or the passing note a resolved-but-not-live write deserves. */\n  readonly tone: 'error' | 'note'\n  readonly text: string\n}\n\n/** Which refusal code reads as which sentence. */\nconst REFUSAL_KEYS = {\n  'management-required': 'builtinReasonManagementRequired',\n  'unaddressable': 'builtinReasonUnaddressable',\n} as const\n\n/** Which restart reason reads as which sentence. */\nconst RESTART_KEYS = {\n  'no-hmr': 'builtinRestartNoHmr',\n  'package-moved': 'builtinRestartPackageMoved',\n  'host-module': 'builtinRestartHostModule',\n  'unmanaged-plugin': 'builtinRestartUnmanagedPlugin',\n  'module-comparison': 'builtinRestartModuleComparison',\n} as const\n\n/** Translate in this package's namespace. */\ntype Translate = BuiltinPluginsProps['t']\n\n/**\n * The one reason a failure this component could not name may show: the manager's\n * own generic code. A caught exception keeps its message out of the interface —\n * a host diagnostic can carry an absolute path — and is logged instead.\n */\nconst FALLBACK_CODE = 'operation-error'\n\n/** Log one caught failure where a developer can read it, naming what failed. */\nfunction warnFailure(what: string, error: unknown): void {\n  console.warn(`plugin-manager: ${what}`, error)\n}\n\n/**\n * What one refusal code reads as. A code this package has no sentence for is\n * shown as the code itself: the manager named it, and a guessed sentence would\n * be worse than the name it gave.\n */\nfunction refusalText(code: string, t: Translate): string {\n  const key = REFUSAL_KEYS[code as keyof typeof REFUSAL_KEYS]\n  return key === undefined ? code : t(key)\n}\n\n/** Why a row's switch is locked, in the reader's language. */\nfunction writeReason(write: WriteState, t: Translate): string {\n  if (write === 'writable') return ''\n  if (write === 'unknown') return t('builtinReasonUnknown')\n  return refusalText(write, t)\n}\n\n/** Why a write needs a restart, in the reader's language. */\nfunction restartReason(reason: string | undefined, t: Translate): string {\n  if (reason === undefined) return t('builtinRestartUnnamed')\n  const key = RESTART_KEYS[reason as keyof typeof RESTART_KEYS]\n  return key === undefined ? t('builtinRestartUnnamed') : t(key)\n}\n\n/** One row's display title, falling back to the module it names. */\nfunction rowTitle(\n  row: { readonly meta?: { readonly title?: DisplayText }; readonly moduleName: string },\n  resolveText: BuiltinPluginsInjected['resolveText'],\n): string {\n  const title = row.meta?.title\n  if (title === undefined) return row.moduleName\n  const resolved = resolveText(title)\n  return resolved === '' ? row.moduleName : resolved\n}\n\n/** One preset row's state, as the composition reports it. */\nfunction presetRowState(row: AgentPresetRow): 'on' | 'off' | 'conditional' {\n  if (row.enabled === 'conditional') return 'conditional'\n  return row.enabled ? 'on' : 'off'\n}\n\n/** One preset row's state text; a conditional row names its own expression. */\nfunction presetRowText(row: AgentPresetRow, t: Translate): string {\n  if (row.enabled === 'conditional') {\n    return row.condition === undefined\n      ? t('presetRowConditionalUnnamed')\n      : t('presetRowConditional', { condition: row.condition })\n  }\n  return row.enabled ? t('presetRowOn') : t('presetRowOff')\n}\n\n/**\n * Read one manager list, treating a refused or failed read as unknown. A row\n * whose writability could not be read is shown locked, never writable.\n */\nasync function readList<T>(read: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<T | undefined> {\n  try {\n    const answer = readRemoteAnswer<T>(await read())\n    if (!answer.ok) return undefined\n    return Array.isArray(answer.value) ? answer.value as T : undefined\n  } catch (error) {\n    warnFailure('built-in group list read failed', error)\n    return undefined\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether an inventory answer is really a snapshot. The namespace hands back\n * `entries`; anything else — a bare null, an envelope with no value, a value\n * whose entries is not a list — is a failure this group reports rather than one\n * it walks into.\n */\nfunction isInventory(value: unknown): value is PluginInventory {\n  return typeof value === 'object'\n    && value !== null\n    && Array.isArray((value as { entries?: unknown }).entries)\n}\n\n/**\n * Read the whole group: the Loader snapshot, then the two manager lists that\n * decide which entries are built-in and which of them can be written.\n * @param remote - the sampled official faces.\n * @returns the group's state; a read this deployment cannot serve stays a state,\n *   never an exception.\n */\nasync function readGroup(remote: RemoteSnapshot): Promise<GroupState> {\n  const inventoryFace = remote.inventory\n  if (inventoryFace === null) return { kind: 'unavailable' }\n  try {\n    const answer = readRemoteAnswer<PluginInventory>(await inventoryFace.list())\n    // A refusal keeps the code the host named; anything else that is not a\n    // snapshot at all is reported as this component's own generic failure.\n    if (!answer.ok) return { kind: 'failed', code: answer.code ?? FALLBACK_CODE }\n    if (!isInventory(answer.value)) return { kind: 'failed', code: FALLBACK_CODE }\n    const inventory = answer.value\n    const manager: ManagerFace | null = remote.manager\n    const [plugins, bundles] = await Promise.all([\n      manager === null ? Promise.resolve(undefined) : readList<readonly PluginFacts[]>(() => manager.listPlugins()),\n      manager === null ? Promise.resolve(undefined) : readList<readonly BundleFacts[]>(() => manager.listBundles()),\n    ])\n    const selection = selectBuiltinEntries(inventory, bundles, plugins)\n    return {\n      kind: 'ready',\n      rows: selection.rows,\n      allRows: selection.allRows,\n      bundles: selection.bundles,\n      presets: Array.isArray(inventory.agentPresets) ? inventory.agentPresets : [],\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    // The whole read is guarded, not just the call: a malformed snapshot would\n    // otherwise reject out of the effect below and leave the group reading for\n    // ever, which reads as a hang rather than as the failure it is.\n    warnFailure('built-in group read failed', error)\n    return { kind: 'failed', code: FALLBACK_CODE }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The group itself. All state is local: the page around it owns the plugin list,\n * and the Loader is the only truth this component reports.\n */\nexport function BuiltinPlugins(props: BuiltinPluginsProps) {\n  const { t, remote, resolveText } = props\n  const [state, setState] = useState<GroupState>({ kind: 'loading' })\n  /** Bumped after an accepted write, so the group reads the Loader again. */\n  const [reload, setReload] = useState(0)\n  /** The one write in flight, mirrored into the switches before the re-read. */\n  const [pending, setPending] = useState<{ entryId: string; enabled: boolean } | undefined>(undefined)\n  /** Synchronous in-flight mirror: two clicks can land in one frame. */\n  const writingRef = useRef(false)\n  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<Notice | undefined>(undefined)\n\n  // A re-read keeps the rows it already shows until the new answer lands, so a\n  // toggle never collapses the list under the pointer.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    let live = true\n    void readGroup(remote).then(next => {\n      if (live) setState(next)\n    })\n    return () => { live = false }\n  }, [remote, reload])\n\n  /**\n   * Which scope the list shows. Switching it only picks between the two sets the\n   * last read already answered with: it never reads again and never touches a\n   * row's enablement, so a reader can widen the list without the Loader moving.\n   */\n  const [scope, setScope] = useState<'default' | 'all'>('default')\n  const listId = useId()\n\n  const ready = state.kind === 'ready' ? state : undefined\n  const rows = ready === undefined ? [] : scope === 'all' ? ready.allRows : ready.rows\n  /** Rows the default scope leaves out: what the scope control would add. */\n  const ownedCount = ready === undefined ? 0 : ready.allRows.length - ready.rows.length\n  const presets = ready === undefined ? [] : ready.presets\n\n  /**\n   * The visible label of each row: its name, and the line under it — the module, or\n   * the entry id when the name already is that module. Two rows carrying the same\n   * pair read identically, which is the only case where the row has to say which\n   * entry it is; a title two rows share is exactly that case, and so is a module\n   * several rows name. Counted over the list on screen, so each scope answers for\n   * itself and switching scope neither reads nor writes anything.\n   */\n  const labels = new Map<string, string>()\n  const labelCounts = new Map<string, number>()\n  for (const row of rows) {\n    const title = rowTitle(row, resolveText)\n    const label = `${title}\\u0000${title === row.moduleName ? row.entryId : row.moduleName}`\n    labels.set(row.entryId, label)\n    labelCounts.set(label, (labelCounts.get(label) ?? 0) + 1)\n  }\n  /** Whether this row's visible labels are shared with another row on screen. */\n  const collides = (entryId: string): boolean => (labelCounts.get(labels.get(entryId) ?? '') ?? 0) > 1\n\n  /**\n   * Ask the official manager to enable or disable one row, then re-read. The\n   * switch moves first and comes back on a refusal, so what it shows afterwards\n   * is the answer this deployment gave rather than the click that produced it.\n   */\n  const toggle = (row: BuiltinRow, next: boolean): void => {\n    const manager = remote.manager\n    if (manager === null || row.write !== 'writable' || writingRef.current) return\n    writingRef.current = true\n    setPending({ entryId: row.entryId, enabled: next })\n    setNotice(undefined)\n    void (async () => {\n      let outcome\n      try {\n        outcome = readChangeResult(await manager.setPluginEnabled(row.entryId, next))\n      } catch (error) {\n        warnFailure('built-in group write failed', error)\n        outcome = { ok: false as const, code: FALLBACK_CODE }\n      }\n      writingRef.current = false\n      setPending(undefined)\n      if (!outcome.ok) {\n        setNotice({\n          tone: 'error',\n          text: t(next ? 'builtinFailedEnable' : 'builtinFailedDisable', { reason: refusalText(outcome.code, t) }),\n        })\n        return\n      }\n      // A resolved write is not always a state the page will keep: the next start\n      // loads a restart-required change, and a higher profile layer wins over an\n      // overridden one. The re-read below is what makes the switch show the Loader\n      // either way; this line is what tells the reader which of the two happened.\n      // A restart-required write is not a success: the change is on disk and the\n      // running process still serves the old state, so it is said in the same\n      // passing tone as an overridden one.\n      setNotice(outcome.application === 'restart-required'\n        ? { tone: 'note', text: t('builtinRestartRequired', { reason: restartReason(outcome.restartReason, t) }) }\n        : outcome.application === 'overridden'\n          ? { tone: 'note', text: t('builtinOverridden', { name: rowTitle(row, resolveText) }) }\n          : undefined)\n      setReload(token => token + 1)\n    })()\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <section\n      className={css.builtinGroup}\n      data-dsh-plugin=\"plugin-manager\"\n      data-dsh-part=\"builtin-group\"\n      data-builtin-state={state.kind}\n      data-builtin-bundles={state.kind === 'ready' ? state.bundles : undefined}\n      data-builtin-scope={scope}\n      aria-busy={state.kind === 'loading'}\n    >\n      <div className={css.builtinHead}>\n        <h3 className={css.builtinTitle}>{t('builtinGroup')}</h3>\n        {ready !== undefined && ready.bundles === 'confirmed' && (\n          <span className={css.builtinCount} data-builtin-count={rows.length}>{rows.length}</span>\n        )}\n        {ownedCount > 0 && (\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            className={css.builtinScope}\n            data-dsh-part=\"builtin-scope\"\n            aria-expanded={scope === 'all'}\n            aria-controls={listId}\n            onClick={() => { setScope(scope === 'all' ? 'default' : 'all') }}\n          >\n            {t(scope === 'all' ? 'builtinScopeCollapse' : 'builtinScopeExpand', { count: String(ownedCount) })}\n          </button>\n        )}\n      </div>\n\n      {state.kind === 'loading' && <p className={css.hint} role=\"status\">{t('builtinReading')}</p>}\n      {state.kind === 'unavailable' && <p className={css.hint}>{t('builtinUnavailable')}</p>}\n      {state.kind === 'failed' && (\n        <p className={css.error} role=\"alert\">{t('builtinFailed', { reason: state.code })}</p>\n      )}\n      {state.kind === 'ready' && state.bundles === 'unconfirmed' && (\n        <p className={css.hint} data-builtin-unconfirmed>{t('builtinUnconfirmed')}</p>\n      )}\n      {notice !== undefined && (\n        <p\n          className={notice.tone === 'error' ? css.error : css.hint}\n          role={notice.tone === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'status'}\n          data-dsh-part=\"builtin-notice\"\n          data-notice-tone={notice.tone}\n        >\n          {notice.text}\n        </p>\n      )}\n      {ready !== undefined && rows.length === 0 && <p className={css.hint}>{t('builtinEmpty')}</p>}\n\n      {rows.length > 0 && (\n        <ul className={css.builtinList} id={listId}>\n          {rows.map(row => {\n            const title = rowTitle(row, resolveText)\n            const reason = writeReason(row.write, t)\n            const locked = row.write !== 'writable'\n            const checked = pending?.entryId === row.entryId ? pending.enabled : row.enabled\n            return (\n              <li\n                key={row.entryId}\n                className={css.builtinRow}\n                data-dsh-part=\"builtin-row\"\n                data-entry-id={row.entryId}\n                data-write={row.write}\n                data-owned-by={row.ownedBy}\n              >\n                <span className={css.builtinMain}>\n                  <span className={css.builtinName}>{title}</span>\n                  <span className={css.builtinModule}>\n                    {title === row.moduleName ? row.entryId : row.moduleName}\n                  </span>\n                  {collides(row.entryId) && (\n                    <span className={css.builtinModule} data-entry-revealed={row.entryId}>{row.entryId}</span>\n                  )}\n                  {row.ownedBy !== undefined && row.ownedBy !== '' && (\n                    <span className={css.builtinOwner} data-dsh-part=\"builtin-owner\">\n                      {t('builtinOwnedBy', { name: row.ownedBy })}\n                    </span>\n                  )}\n                  {locked && <span className={css.builtinReason}>{reason}</span>}\n                </span>\n                <Switch\n                  checked={checked}\n                  label={t('builtinToggle', { name: title })}\n                  disabled={locked || pending !== undefined || remote.manager === null}\n                  {...locked ? { title: reason } : {}}\n                  onChange={next => { toggle(row, next) }}\n                />\n              </li>\n            )\n          })}\n        </ul>\n      )}\n\n      {presets.length > 0 && (\n        <section className={css.presetGroup} data-dsh-part=\"preset-group\">\n          <h4 className={css.presetTitle}>{t('presetGroup')}</h4>\n          <ul className={css.presetList}>\n            {presets.map(preset => (\n              <li\n                key={preset.id}\n                className={css.presetCard}\n                data-dsh-part=\"preset\"\n                data-preset-id={preset.id}\n                data-default={preset.isDefault ? 'yes' : 'no'}\n              >\n                <span className={css.presetHead}>\n                  <span className={css.presetName}>{preset.name ?? preset.id}</span>\n                  {preset.isDefault && <span className={css.presetTag}>{t('presetDefault')}</span>}\n                </span>\n                {preset.broken === undefined ? (\n                  <ul className={css.presetRows}>\n                    {preset.rows.map((row, index) => (\n                      <li\n                        key={row.entryId ?? `${preset.id}:${String(index)}`}\n                        className={css.presetRow}\n                        data-dsh-part=\"preset-row\"\n                        data-preset-state={presetRowState(row)}\n                      >\n                        <span className={css.presetRowName}>{row.moduleName}</span>\n                        <span className={css.presetRowState}>{presetRowText(row, t)}</span>\n                      </li>\n                    ))}\n                  </ul>\n                ) : (\n                  <p className={css.hint}>{t('presetBroken', { reason: preset.broken })}</p>\n                )}\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ul>\n        </section>\n      )}\n    </section>\n  )\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-plugin-manager/src/client/PluginListToolbar.tsx",
      "content": "/**\n * The list-level toolbar: check every installed third-party plugin for a newer\n * registry release, apply them in one run, then restart DSH to load them.\n *\n * It exists because the official Plugins page compares one package at a time\n * (its `plugins.detail.section` contributions render on a bundle's page), while\n * the answer a user wants when they open the page is \"is anything of mine out\n * of date, and can I just fix it\". It is mounted beside the page's \"Installed\"\n * heading (see plugin-toolbar-mount.tsx) because that heading is the page's own\n * chrome and the page declares no seat next to it.\n *\n * Policy lives in core/updates.ts (third-party only, compatibility-gated) and\n * the operations come from the injected face, so this component is pure\n * rendering plus the sequence of calls: nothing here touches the DOM beyond its\n * own subtree.\n * @module @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager/client\n */\n\nimport { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'\nimport type { PropsLocale } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots'\nimport type { PluginUpdateItem, PluginUpdateResult, RestartMode, RestartPlanWire } from '../core/protocol.ts'\nimport { applicableUpdates, thirdPartyUpdates } from '../core/updates.ts'\nimport { displayMinimumVersion } from '../core/version.ts'\nimport { dshGateOf } from './PluginUpdatePatch.tsx'\nimport css from './plugin-manager.module.css'\n\n/** The operations the toolbar drives (the package's dual-channel face). */\nexport interface PluginListToolbarInjected {\n  /** Whether this browser has loopback authority to use the host routes. */\n  isLoopback: boolean\n  /** Compare every installed plugin against the version its source serves. */\n  checkUpdates: () => Promise<PluginUpdateItem[]>\n  /**\n   * Re-install one plugin from its recorded source. Resolves with what landed:\n   * the row at the new version, plus the bundles only a restart loads. A landed\n   * update that needs a restart keeps the batch running instead of failing it.\n   */\n  update: (id: string) => Promise<PluginUpdateResult>\n  /**\n   * Read how a restart would be carried out, without carrying it out: the\n   * confirmation must name the same consequence the host will produce (an\n   * in-place relaunch, the packaged Desktop shell's own recovery dialog, a\n   * systemd unit restart, or a manual restart), and a plan read has no side\n   * effects. A systemd plan carries the unit it would restart.\n   */\n  restartPlan: () => Promise<RestartPlanWire>\n  /** Restart the host so an applied update is loaded. */\n  restart: () => Promise<RestartMode>\n}\n\n/** Full component props. */\nexport type PluginListToolbarProps =\n  & PropsLocale<'settings.pluginManager'>\n  & PluginListToolbarInjected\n\n/** Error text for a caught request or lifecycle failure. */\nfunction messageOf(error: unknown): string {\n  if (error instanceof AggregateError) {\n    const details = error.errors.map(messageOf).join('; ')\n    return details === '' ? error.message : `${error.message}: ${details}`\n  }\n  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n}\n\n/** Translate in this package's namespace. */\ntype Translate = PluginListToolbarProps['t']\n\n/**\n * The consequence confirming produces, in the reader's language. It states\n * what the host will actually do, so a systemd plan names the unit that goes\n * down and comes back.\n */\nfunction planCopy(plan: RestartPlanWire | undefined, t: Translate): string {\n  // The wire is a discriminated union: a systemd plan carries the unit this\n  // copy must name, and no other mode has one to read.\n  if (plan?.mode === 'systemd') return t('restartPlanSystemd', { unit: plan.unit })\n  if (plan?.mode === 'shell') return t('restartPlanShell')\n  if (plan?.mode === 'manual') return t('restartPlanManual')\n  return t('restartPlanRelaunch')\n}\n\n/** What the toolbar is currently doing. */\ntype Phase = 'idle' | 'checking' | 'updating'\n\n/** Which flyout is open under the buttons. */\ntype Panel = 'none' | 'list' | 'restart'\n\n/**\n * The toolbar itself. The official faces are sampled per render and the subscription below\n  // covers both a language switch and a host-side change event, so the mounted\n  // copy never holds a stale answer.\n  ctx.effect(() => {\n    try {\n      return mountBuiltinPluginGroup({\n        props: () => ({\n          remote: getRemoteSnapshot(),\n          resolveText: text => ctx.locale.resolveText(text),\n          t: ctx.locale.bind(NS),\n        }),\n        subscribe: listener => {\n          const offLocale = ctx.locale.subscribe(listener)\n          const offRemote = subscribeRemote(listener)\n          return () => {\n            offLocale()\n            offRemote()\n          }\n        },\n      })\n    } catch (error) {\n      // The group is chrome on someone else's page: a failed mount must not take\n      // the page down, but it must not disappear without a trace either.\n      console.warn('plugin-manager: mounting the built-in plugin group failed', error)\n      return () => {}\n    }\n  }, 'plugin-manager: built-in plugin group')\n\n  // The official Plugins page declares this seat on its main-panel entry and\n  // renders one section per contribution on each bundle / row / plugin page;\n  // `inject` waits for that declaration, exactly like the family plugin cards\n  // that register into `plugins.bundle.config`.\n  ctx.slots.inject('plugins.detail.section', () => {\n    try {\n      return ctx.slots.register({\n        name: 'plugins.detail.section',\n        id: 'family-update-check',\n        order: 30,\n        locale: NS,\n        inject: () => face,\n      }, PluginUpdatePatch)\n    } catch {\n      return () => {}\n    }\n  })\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-plugin-manager/src/client/telemetry.ts",
      "content": "// Generated by scripts/sync-shared.mjs from shared/client/telemetry.ts. Do not edit this copy; edit the shared source and run \"node scripts/sync-shared.mjs\".\n/**\n * Anonymous install telemetry shared by the DSH Web UI family plugins.\n *\n * Once per UTC day per browser, each wired plugin sends one heartbeat to\n * the dsh-market edge API listing its package name (and version when known).\n * The payload carries no conversation data and no identifiers beyond a random\n * UUID generated in localStorage; the server hashes it with a deployment salt\n * before storage and never persists IP addresses. Sends are fire-and-forget:\n * failures stay silent and simply retry on a later mount or day. Frames where\n * storage is unavailable report nothing.\n *\n * The family-wide opt-out and the browser's Do Not Track signal both suppress\n * the heartbeat; the Web Plugins settings switch writes the same localStorage\n * key. The system is documented in docs/telemetry.md.\n */\n\nexport type TelemetryChannel = 'market' | 'npm' | 'unknown'\n\nexport interface TelemetryItem {\n  /** npm package name or asset id, e.g. \"@linxin666/dsh-pet\" or \"skin:harbor\". */\n  name: string\n  /** Installed version when known; omitted otherwise. */\n  version?: string\n  /** Install channel when determinable (market = Workshop install). */\n  channel?: TelemetryChannel\n}\n\n/** localStorage key carrying the family-wide telemetry opt-out ('1' = off). */\nexport const TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT_KEY = 'dsh-web-ui-telemetry-opt-out'\n\nconst VISITOR_KEY = 'dsh-web-ui-telemetry-visitor'\nconst DAY_KEY_PREFIX = 'dsh-web-ui-telemetry-day:'\nconst ENDPOINT = 'https://dsh-market.com/api/telemetry/event'\n\n// Baked into each client bundle by shared/tsdown.client.ts (the package's own\n// package.json version at build time). Undefined in dev/test builds.\ndeclare const __DSH_PKG_VERSION__: string | undefined\n\n/** The building package's version, when the bundle carries it. */\nfunction bakedVersion(): string | undefined {\n  try {\n    return typeof __DSH_PKG_VERSION__ === 'string' && __DSH_PKG_VERSION__ !== ''\n      ? __DSH_PKG_VERSION__\n      : undefined\n  } catch {\n    return undefined\n  }\n}\n\n/** Whether the user switched the family-wide opt-out on (reads storage only). */\nexport function isTelemetryOptedOut(): boolean {\n  try {\n    return localStorage.getItem(TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT_KEY) === '1'\n  } catch {\n    // Storage unavailable: there is no stored opt-out to honour.\n    return false\n  }\n}\n\n/** Turn the family-wide opt-out on or off (writing '1' / removing the key); never throws. */\nexport function setTelemetryOptedOut(optedOut: boolean): void {\n  try {\n    if (optedOut) localStorage.setItem(TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT_KEY, '1')\n    else localStorage.removeItem(TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT_KEY)\n  } catch {\n    // Storage unavailable: the preference cannot be persisted on this machine.\n  }\n}\n\n/** Whether the browser itself asks not to be tracked; a failed read means no signal. */\nfunction doNotTrackRequested(): boolean {\n  try {\n    // '1' per the DNT header spec, 'yes' from older Firefox builds.\n    return navigator.doNotTrack === '1' || navigator.doNotTrack === 'yes'\n  } catch {\n    return false\n  }\n}\n\n/** Whether a heartbeat must be suppressed right now: opt-out stored, or the browser asks not to be tracked. */\nexport function isTelemetrySuppressed(): boolean {\n  return isTelemetryOptedOut() || doNotTrackRequested()\n}\n\n/** Read or lazily create the anonymous visitor id; null when storage is unavailable. */\nfunction visitorId(): string | null {\n  try {\n    const existing = localStorage.getItem(VISITOR_KEY)\n    if (existing && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}$/.test(existing)) return existing\n    const fresh = crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll('-', '')\n    localStorage.setItem(VISITOR_KEY, fresh)\n    return fresh\n  } catch {\n    // Storage unavailable (privacy mode, sandboxed frame): report nothing.\n    return null\n  }\n}\n\n/** Drop stale per-day dedup keys so localStorage does not grow forever. */\nfunction pruneDayKeys(today: string): void {\n  try {\n    for (let index = localStorage.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {\n      const key = localStorage.key(index)\n      if (key !== null && key.startsWith(DAY_KEY_PREFIX) && key !== DAY_KEY_PREFIX + today) {\n        localStorage.removeItem(key)\n      }\n    }\n  } catch { /* best effort */ }\n}\n\n/**\n * Fire the daily heartbeat for the given items at most once per UTC day per\n * browser. Never throws and never blocks the caller. Items without an explicit\n * version inherit the bundle's baked build version.\n */\nexport function reportDailyHeartbeat(items: readonly TelemetryItem[]): void {\n  try {\n    // First guard: a stored opt-out or the browser's Do Not Track stops every\n    // read below from minting an id, marking the day, or reaching the network.\n    if (isTelemetrySuppressed()) return\n    if (items.length === 0) return\n    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)\n    // Automation contexts (CDP-driven QA browsers, fresh isolated profiles)\n    // mint a new visitor id per run and would inflate instance counts.\n    if (navigator.webdriver) return\n    if (localStorage.getItem(DAY_KEY_PREFIX + today) !== null) return\n    const visitor = visitorId()\n    if (visitor === null) return\n    pruneDayKeys(today)\n    const payloadItems = items.map((item) => {\n      const out: Record<string, string> = { name: item.name }\n      const version = item.version ?? bakedVersion()\n      if (version !== undefined) out.version = version\n      if (item.channel !== undefined) out.channel = item.channel\n      return out\n    })\n    const body = JSON.stringify({ kind: 'heartbeat', visitor, items: payloadItems })\n    void fetch(ENDPOINT, {\n      method: 'POST',\n      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },\n      body,\n      keepalive: true,\n    }).then((response) => {\n      // Mark the day only after an accepted send, so offline browsers retry\n      // on a later mount instead of going dark until tomorrow.\n      if (response.ok) localStorage.setItem(DAY_KEY_PREFIX + today, '1')\n    }).catch(() => { /* unreachable endpoint: stay silent */ })\n  } catch { /* never break the host UI over telemetry */ }\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-plugin-manager/src/core/updates.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Which update rows the list-level toolbar may act on. Pure, shared by the\n * browser half (the toolbar) and its tests: the host answers with every\n * installed package whose registry source serves a newer release, and the\n * policy of what may be updated in bulk lives here rather than in the host,\n * so the same rows stay available to the per-page update block.\n *\n * Two filters:\n *\n * - **Third-party only.** A package published under the `@deepseek-ai/` scope\n *   ships with DSH itself: its version is chosen by the running installation,\n *   the official page says an upgrade arrives by upgrading DSH, and a\n *   plugin-initiated `pnpm add` of such a package can pull a release the runtime was\n *   never tested against. The bulk action therefore never touches it.\n * - **Compatibility gate.** An update whose manifest declares a DSH minimum the\n *   running host does not satisfy is listed (the user may still upgrade DSH)\n *   but cannot be applied: the host would refuse it with 412 anyway.\n * @module @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager/core\n */\n\nimport type { PluginUpdateItem } from './protocol.ts'\n\n/** The npm scope DSH's own packages are published under. */\nexport const OFFICIAL_SCOPE = '@deepseek-ai/'\n\n/** Whether a package id is a third-party plugin rather than a DSH-shipped one. */\nexport function isThirdPartyPlugin(id: string): boolean {\n  return !id.startsWith(OFFICIAL_SCOPE)\n}\n\n/** The third-party update rows, in host order. */\nexport function thirdPartyUpdates(items: readonly PluginUpdateItem[]): PluginUpdateItem[] {\n  return items.filter(item => isThirdPartyPlugin(item.id))\n}\n\n/** Whether the running DSH host satisfies the row's declared minimum. */\nexport function isUpdateApplicable(item: PluginUpdateItem): boolean {\n  return item.compatible !== false\n}\n\n/** The third-party rows this runtime can actually apply. */\nexport function applicableUpdates(items: readonly PluginUpdateItem[]): PluginUpdateItem[] {\n  return thirdPartyUpdates(items).filter(isUpdateApplicable)\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-plugin-manager/src/core/version.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Version parsing plus the requirement reader for the update compatibility\n * check. The declared minimum lives in the published package manifest under\n * `dsh.engines.dsh`, falling back to the top-level `engines.dsh` and then to\n * the `@deepseek-ai/dsh` peer; the range forms a manifest may use are the\n * full node-semver range grammar.\n *\n * This module is shared by both halves and therefore stays free of `semver`,\n * which is a node package: it parses and compares a single `X.Y.Z[-pre]`\n * version, which is all the browser half needs to render a declared range\n * (`displayMinimumVersion`) and all the host half needs to accept a probed\n * host version (`parseDshVersion`). The range verdict itself lives in the\n * host-only `../host/dsh-compat.ts`, which evaluates the declaration with\n * `semver.satisfies(host, range, { includePrerelease: true })` — the exact\n * call the official boot gate makes, so `||`, `^`, `~`, multi-comparator\n * and x-ranges all decide the same way here as they do at boot.\n *\n * Everything here is pure and tolerant of untrusted input: a malformed value\n * means \"cannot verify\", which the callers treat as a fail-closed verdict\n * when a requirement was declared (issue #754).\n * @module @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager/core\n */\n\n/** One parsed DSH host or package version. */\nexport interface DshVersion {\n  major: number\n  minor: number\n  patch: number\n  /** Prerelease identifiers, numeric identifiers kept as numbers (semver order). */\n  prerelease: readonly (number | string)[]\n}\n\nconst VERSION_PATTERN = /^v?(\\d+)\\.(\\d+)\\.(\\d+)(?:-([0-9A-Za-z.-]+))?$/\n\n/**\n * Parse a DSH host or package version string.\n * @param value - e.g. `0.1.0-rc.8`, `v1.2.3`.\n * @returns the parsed version, or undefined when malformed.\n */\nexport function parseDshVersion(value: string): DshVersion | undefined {\n  const match = VERSION_PATTERN.exec(value.trim())\n  if (match === null) return undefined\n  const prereleaseParts = match[4] === undefined ? [] : match[4].split('.')\n  if (prereleaseParts.some(part => part === '')) return undefined\n  return {\n    major: Number(match[1]),\n    minor: Number(match[2]),\n    patch: Number(match[3]),\n    prerelease: prereleaseParts.map(part => /^\\d+$/.test(part) ? Number(part) : part),\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Compare two version strings by semver order (a release is newer than any\n * prerelease of the same tuple).\n * @returns -1 / 0 / 1, or undefined when either side is malformed.\n */\nexport function compareVersions(left: string, right: string): number | undefined {\n  const a = parseDshVersion(left)\n  const b = parseDshVersion(right)\n  if (a === undefined || b === undefined) return undefined\n  for (const key of ['major', 'minor', 'patch'] as const) {\n    if (a[key] !== b[key]) return a[key] < b[key] ? -1 : 1\n  }\n  return comparePrerelease(a.prerelease, b.prerelease)\n}\n\n/**\n * Semver prerelease ordering: numeric identifiers compare numerically,\n * numeric identifiers rank below alphanumeric ones, alphanumeric identifiers\n * compare lexically, and a longer list wins when the shared prefix is equal.\n */\nfunction comparePrerelease(left: readonly (number | string)[], right: readonly (number | string)[]): number {\n  if (left.length === 0 && right.length === 0) return 0\n  if (left.length === 0) return 1\n  if (right.length === 0) return -1\n  const length = Math.max(left.length, right.length)\n  for (let index = 0; index < length; index += 1) {\n    const a = left[index]\n    const b = right[index]\n    if (a === undefined) return -1\n    if (b === undefined) return 1\n    if (typeof a === 'number' && typeof b === 'number') {\n      if (a !== b) return a < b ? -1 : 1\n    } else if (typeof a === 'number') {\n      return -1\n    } else if (typeof b === 'number') {\n      return 1\n    } else if (a !== b) {\n      return a < b ? -1 : 1\n    }\n  }\n  return 0\n}\n\nconst MINIMUM_RANGE_PATTERN = /^>=\\s*(v?\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?)$/\n\n/**\n * The bare minimum version for display: strips the `>=` operator (and an\n * optional leading `v`) from a declared requirement so UI copy that already\n * contains the comparison operator renders `0.1.1-rc.1` instead of\n * `>= >=0.1.1-rc.1`. Every other range form renders unchanged — the browser\n * half does not evaluate a range (the host does, in `../host/dsh-compat.ts`),\n * so it must not pull a range parser into the client bundle to shorten copy.\n * @param minimum - the declared minimum range.\n * @returns the version portion for display.\n */\nexport function displayMinimumVersion(minimum: string): string {\n  const match = MINIMUM_RANGE_PATTERN.exec(minimum.trim())\n  return match === null ? minimum.trim() : match[1].replace(/^v/, '')\n}\n\n/**\n * Read the declared DSH minimum from a published registry manifest:\n * `dsh.engines.dsh` first, top-level `engines.dsh` next, and\n * `peerDependencies[\"@deepseek-ai/dsh\"]` last, which is where a package that\n * only declares the host as a peer still gets gated at boot.\n * Defensive against malformed or untrusted metadata: anything that is not a\n * non-empty string reads as absent.\n * @param manifest - the decoded registry version manifest.\n * @returns the declared minimum, or undefined when not declared.\n */\nexport function dshRequirementOf(manifest: { dsh?: unknown; engines?: unknown; peerDependencies?: unknown }): string | undefined {\n  const dshEngines = (manifest.dsh as { engines?: unknown } | undefined)?.engines as { dsh?: unknown } | undefined\n  const engines = (manifest.engines as { dsh?: unknown } | undefined)?.dsh\n  const peers = (manifest.peerDependencies as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.['@deepseek-ai/dsh']\n  // The host's own peer gate is the LAST word: a package that declares the\n  // host only under peerDependencies still gets that row skipped at boot when\n  // the floor is not met, so a requirement we display must come from the same\n  // place the gate reads, or the user is told nothing and then loses the row.\n  const value = dshEngines?.dsh ?? engines ?? peers\n  return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() !== '' ? value.trim() : undefined\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/dsh-plugin-manager/src/host/dsh-compat.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * The DSH runtime compatibility verdict for one declared plugin requirement,\n * evaluated the way the official boot gate evaluates it\n * (`evaluatePluginCompatibility` in app-boot's `plugin-compatibility.ts`):\n * the requirement is a node-semver range and the host satisfies it when\n * `semver.satisfies(host, range, { includePrerelease: true })` holds. Every\n * legal range form therefore decides: `||` alternatives, `^` and `~`,\n * whitespace-separated comparators, x-ranges, and prerelease tags compared as\n * ordinary versions.\n *\n * The requirement itself comes from `dshRequirementOf` in\n * `../core/version.ts`, which owns the field priority (this module only\n * decides the verdict). Host-only on purpose: `semver` is a node package and\n * must never be reachable from the browser half, which renders the same\n * declaration through the regex-only `displayMinimumVersion`.\n * @module @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager/host\n */\n\nimport semver from 'semver'\n\n/**\n * The verdict for one declared requirement, with its cause kept apart so\n * callers can tell \"this host is too old\" from \"we could not check\".\n *\n * The distinction is user-visible: a `host-too-low` verdict is the only one\n * that may tell the user to upgrade DSH, because it is the only one where a\n * running version was actually compared and lost. An `unverifiable` verdict\n * means the question was never answered — an absent declaration, a range\n * node-semver rejects, or a host string that is not one valid version — so\n * telling the user to upgrade would send them after a fix nobody confirmed was\n * needed (issue #1819), and reporting it as \"below the minimum\" contradicts a\n * declaration that may well be satisfied (issue #1899).\n */\nexport type DshCompatibility =\n  | { verdict: 'satisfied' }\n  | { verdict: 'host-too-low' }\n  | { verdict: 'unverifiable' }\n\n/**\n * Decide whether the running DSH host satisfies a declared requirement range.\n * @param host - the running DSH host version.\n * @param range - the declared requirement, in any node-semver range form.\n * @returns `satisfied` when the host satisfies the declaration,\n * `host-too-low` when it was compared and does not, and `unverifiable` when\n * no comparison could be made. Callers fail closed on the last two (issue\n * #754) but must not describe them with the same words.\n */\nexport function evaluateDshCompatibility(host: string, range: string): DshCompatibility {\n  // `semver.validRange('')` answers `'*'`, so an absent declaration would\n  // otherwise read as an unconstrained range and become a satisfied verdict.\n  // The official gate keeps the same `range.trim() !== ''` guard for the\n  // same reason.\n  if (range.trim() === '') return { verdict: 'unverifiable' }\n  if (semver.validRange(range) === null) return { verdict: 'unverifiable' }\n  // A host string that is not a single valid version is \"cannot verify\", not\n  // \"too old\": `semver.satisfies` would silently answer false for it.\n  if (semver.valid(host) === null) return { verdict: 'unverifiable' }\n  return semver.satisfies(host, range, { includePrerelease: true })\n    ? { verdict: 'satisfied' }\n    : { verdict: 'host-too-low' }\n}\n"
